steps.d: Open Live and press Start a class, then add a title.
Choose YouTube, the AllCoaching classroom or Zoom.
For the classroom, use this computer, your phone or OBS.
Start now or schedule it, and open it to everyone or one course.
Press Create and go live, and the class begins.

faq.q: How do I take live classes online?
faq.a: In Live, start a new class and pick where it streams: YouTube Live, Zoom, or the AllCoaching classroom. Then choose when it starts and who can watch.

faq.q: Zoom or YouTube Live for teaching?
faq.a: Both work. YouTube suits large classes on your own channel with no viewer limit; Zoom suits two-way classes where students speak and raise a hand. Live classes on either are unlimited on every plan.

faq.q: Can I stream from my phone, computer or OBS?
faq.a: Yes. Into the AllCoaching classroom you can stream from this computer, from your phone by scanning a code, or from OBS or any encoder with a server address and stream key.
Classes in the AllCoaching classroom are recorded and saved with the class on their own. YouTube classes keep their replay on your channel, and students can keep watching it in your academy.

faq.q: How many hours does the built-in classroom include?
faq.a: On monthly plans the built-in classroom includes 20, 50 or 90 hours a month on Starter, Growth and Pro. On yearly plans it is 5, 10 or 15 hours a month. YouTube Live and Zoom classes are unlimited and separate from these hours.
